naming_rule: Pair is always named 'AGENT BASELINE v<N> do not edit' and 'AGENT WORKING v<N> edit here', same N for both. On every resync, increment N. See AGENT.md §1.
notes: v4 is the FULL MERGE of everything: duplicated from the theme that is currently live and published (originally named 'Manus Edits 1', which itself already contained catalog-move, market-news-reorder, inline-email-contrast-fix, both article-template email footers, and the company-final-cta cream-card contrast fix). The ONLY thing missing from that live theme was the rotating company module, which has now been added on top. As of this write, AGENT WORKING v4 = complete state, ready to hand off for conversion to a coded website. This is the reference version for that conversion.

entries.description: Moved 'One company. The complete file.' section from homepage to Catalog page.
CSS flex order fix so Market News + Short Takes render before Featured Pitch on the homepage 'Fin. by Mintmark' section.
Fixed low-contrast heading/description text in the 'Understanding to your inbox' inline email section.
Added 'JOIN THE PAPER' email section to bottom of both article templates so every article, current and future, gets it automatically.

On company pages, the Company Final CTA section's cream pathway card ('Return to the Bookshelf') had invisible text — its color was tied to panel_color, which had been set equal to paper_color on the Apple page. Fixed by pointing the cream card's text at the dedicated text-color variable instead of panel_color, so it can't break this way again on any company page.

The 'One company. The complete file.' section on the Catalog page now auto-rotates through 10 companies every 4 seconds with a fade transition: Apple (FILE 01), NVIDIA (02), Alphabet/Google (03), Roblox (04), Amazon (05), Microsoft (06), Tesla (07), Netflix (08), Costco (09), Disney (10). Rotates folio number, ticker, exchange, company name, subtitle, summary, sector, headquarters, and a generated ticker-badge in place of the logo. The book/digest panel and tagged-stories panel stay static (still Apple's) — full per-company pages/data not built yet, by design.
entries.status: NOT YET PUBLISHED — only in v4

history_note: Full session history (v1 through v3, including two mid-session drift-resyncs and one accidental theme deletion) is preserved in AGENT.md and prior changelog entries on the now-superseded v1–v3 theme pairs. This v4 changelog is intentionally condensed to just the substantive changes for handoff clarity.
